baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v7 holdouts were promoted to regression after evaluation. The v8 holdouts were selected and truth-labelled after the final candidate revision and before its first v8 run, and must not be used to revise that candidate.

invariants: Only containers carrying the BCRS Deposit Mark are eligible for a refund.
The refund is S$0.10 per eligible container.
Containers without the mark remain recyclable through blue bins or other recycling stations.
